semiconductor_relevance: High — SinceVision specializes in high-precision measurement solutions that are critical for semiconductor fabrication and quality control.
summary: SinceVision Technology manufactures advanced sensor technology and high-speed imaging systems, providing essential tools for non-contact 3D measurement in semiconductor manufacturing. Their products enhance quality control and efficiency in various applications, including semiconductor fabrication and packaging.

regional_presence.China: SinceVision is a national-level key enterprise based in China, focusing on the R&D and production of industrial sensors.
